answer: Two steps seal the lagoon against tides of fake voyagers. First, agents stamp each receipt with a tide-print—its gradient encoded in vine-carbon isotopes. Second, auditors pull at random and burn any that fail mass-spect parity. Cost: per Sybil, 0.54 megajoules of serialised isotope oven burn—no greenhouse clones cut the carbon line faster than nature can raise vines, and each cheat costs the tree a year of growth lost.
